title: Basis on Which Reductions Are Taken on a Resort Lodging Room Rate
content:
Reductions on the room rate of a Resort Lodging reservation are worked out in a fixed order and the result is frozen on the reservation.

## Clauses no longer in force

Three clauses of this basis have been superseded by the current basis on which the room rate for a stay is worked out, and are no longer in force. They are recorded here so that no reader applies them:

1. That the season passholder reduction is taken first, on the evidence of a pass held by the household standing in the active state on the arrival date, is no longer in force.
2. That the advance booking reduction is taken next where the reservation was recorded at least the unit type's advance period before arrival is no longer in force.
3. That the length-of-stay reduction is taken last where the stay reaches the unit type's threshold in nights is no longer in force.

## Clauses in force

The reductions are worked out in a fixed order, and once worked out the result is frozen on the reservation.

Where several reservations on one household account share a set of dates, each is priced on its own and the nights are not pooled to reach a length-of-stay threshold.

A reduction given at booking is not taken away when a later change makes the stay shorter, but a change that lengthens the stay is priced on the reductions that apply at the moment of the change.

### Points of judgement (hypothetical households)

A household holding two Slopeside Studio reservations over the same week, one of 4 nights and one of 3 nights, is priced on each reservation separately; the 7 nights are not added together to reach a length-of-stay threshold on either of them.

A household whose 8-night stay was priced at booking and is afterwards shortened to 5 nights keeps the reductions it was given: a later change that makes the stay shorter does not take a reduction away. Where the same household instead lengthens the stay, the change is priced on the reductions that apply at the moment of the change rather than on those that applied at booking.

superseded_clauses: The season passholder reduction is taken first, on the evidence of a pass held by the household standing in the active state on the arrival date.
The advance booking reduction is taken next where the reservation was recorded at least the unit type's advance period before arrival.
The length-of-stay reduction is taken last where the stay reaches the unit type's threshold in nights.
